errors.unsupported_output_language.messa: The requested AI output language is not supported.

errors.destructive_challenge_mismatch.me: The confirmation code does not match. Nothing was changed.

Refresh and confirm the updated scope.

errors.forbidden.action: Refresh and retry. Export diagnostics if the issue persists.
errors.conflict.message: The data changed. The newer state has been preserved.
errors.rate_limited.message: Too many requests, or the external provider is rate-limiting calls.
errors.rate_limited.action: Wait a moment or reduce concurrency.

errors.internal_error.action: Export diagnostics and note the action you were performing.
